scenario.name: r-cw-multi-producer
scenario.description: One turn schedules three typed elections with exact reasons and delays; three distinct successor runs each complete exactly once.

expectedReceipts.name: three-distinct-elections
expectedReceipts.description: Three unique continue_work toolCallIds and three unique TaskFlow flowIds share the originating run.

expectedReceipts.name: exactly-one-wake-per-election
expectedReceipts.description: Three distinct successor run IDs settle, each mapped once to one expected delay/reason; repeated observations are deduplicated.

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Fresh trace ID for the nonce-rendered immediate election.

review.notes: This is staggered multi-election behavior, never active folding or R-CW-MULTI-COLLAPSE. Multi-token fanout is unsupported; token parity remains the separate token row.

census.limits: Three TaskFlows and lifecycle runs prove multiplicity; spans remain behavioral-only without product identity attributes.

redaction.rule: Persist reason hashes and structured flow/run fingerprints; never raw prompts, tokens, or transcripts.

controls.positive: Three exact reasons map to three flows and wakes.
controls.negative: Duplicate flow IDs or repeated wake observations fail.

verdictAuthority.pass: All three flow/run elections are complete.
verdictAuthority.partial: Telemetry or rebind prerequisites are unavailable.
verdictAuthority.fail: Multiplicity, uniqueness, or wake completion fails.

execution.manual: Independent reviewer inspects flow/run and raw trace receipts.
execution.relationship: TaskFlow identity establishes multiplicity; trace receipt covers the nonce-rendered immediate election.

liveRunSafety.notes: Observe for at least 130 seconds. One surviving election, duplicate wake observations, or fold/collapse evidence fails.
